sections.title: PAYEE DETAILS  (single search on payee code or name - every other field is pulled from the payee register and is read-only)

fields.validation: Auto-generated using the enterprise prefix; unique, immutable and gapless.
Must fall in an open accounting period.

Bill payment / Advance to vendor / Direct Expense / Indirect Expense. GATING FIELD - drives which references are mandatory: Bill payment opens fields 3.1 to 3.3 (bill reference, bill dates, bill approval status); Advance to vendor opens fields 3.5 and 3.6 (advance request and total value of scope); Direct and Indirect Expense require the GL expense head and approval. Verified by the check in field 3.7. Tax, government fee and staff salary payments are NOT raised on this form.
Paying entity from sheet 01.
Location the payment relates to.
Required where the payment is not against a booked bill.
PKR by default; rate required for foreign currency payments.
Online transfer (RTGS / IBFT) / Cheque / Pay order / Demand draft / Letter of credit / Cash.
Enterprise bank account; the available balance is checked before release.
Mandatory for cheque, pay order and demand draft payments.
Draft / Pending approval / Approved / Released / Cleared / Bounced / Cancelled - with effective date.

NO MANUAL ENTRY. Derived from the payee record selected in field 2.2: Manufacturer / Distributor / Transporter / Fuel supplier / Workshop or maintenance vendor / Spare parts & tyre supplier / Vehicle or equipment hire vendor / Insurance company / Service vendor / Utility / Other trade party.

THE ONLY SEARCHABLE FIELD IN THIS SECTION. Type-ahead search on payee code OR registered name against the vendor register; the user must pick an existing active record. Selecting it populates fields 2.1 and 2.3 to 2.10 automatically. Free-text entry of a payee is not permitted - the party must first be onboarded on sheet 02, 03 or 05.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the payee master; used for withholding tax reporting and must match the NTN on the bill.

fields.field: Payee filer status on the payment date
fields.validation: NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the payee record as at the payment date; a lapsed ATL validity triggers non-filer withholding rates.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the verified payee bank record selected in field 2.7.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the payee bank record; must match the payee's registered legal name - a mismatch blocks release.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Pulled from the payee bank record; where several verified accounts exist the user selects one.
Verified / Not verified. An unverified account blocks the release of the voucher.
NO MANUAL ENTRY. Mobile pulled from the points-of-contact block of the payee record; the remittance advice is sent there automatically on release.
Total payable to this payee across all open bills.
MANDATORY WHERE FIELD 1.3 = BILL PAYMENT. One or more approved bills from sheet 08; the voucher cannot be raised for a bill payment without a bill reference here.
Pulled from the bills referenced in field 3.1; required for bill payments. Early payment requires approval.
Pulled from the bills referenced in field 3.1; required for bill payments. Only bills with status Approved can be paid - an unapproved bill is rejected by the system.
Pulled from the bill for the audit trail.
MANDATORY WHERE FIELD 1.3 = ADVANCE TO VENDOR. The advance request must be approved before the voucher can be released; the scope it relates to is valued in field 3.6.

MANDATORY WHERE FIELD 1.3 = ADVANCE TO VENDOR. Total value of the full scope the advance relates to - the purchase order, work order, trip contract or supply agreement value against which the money is being paid ahead of delivery. The system shows the advance as a percentage of this value, checks it against the advance ceiling in the vendor contract, and keeps the balance scope open until bills are booked against it.

Pass / Fail on the references required by the payment type in field 1.3. BILL PAYMENT: fields 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 must all be completed and the bill approval status in 3.3 must read Approved - the voucher cannot be raised or released otherwise. ADVANCE TO VENDOR: fields 3.5 and 3.6 must be completed and the advance request approved. DIRECT or INDIRECT EXPENSE: the GL expense head in field 4.2 and the approval attachment are required. A Fail blocks the voucher.
MANDATORY WHERE FIELD 1.3 = DIRECT EXPENSE OR INDIRECT EXPENSE. Approved expense requisition or claim authorising the payment where there is no vendor bill.
Pass / Fail - confirms every mandatory attachment for the payment type is present.
REPEATING BLOCK - one line per bill or expense head being settled.
Payable account, advance account or expense head - including fuel, running repairs, spares and tyres, vehicle hire, insurance, tolls and other delivery-fleet operating heads.
Pulled from the referenced bill.
Prior payments against the same bill.
Income tax and sales tax withheld, pulled from the bill.
Shortage, penalty and other recoveries from the bill.

fields.validation: Mandatory for freight, fuel, maintenance and hire payments; supports the vehicle and trip reference on the bill.
Signed instruction or the scanned instrument.
Confirmation of the debit from the bank.
